title: SEIS Second Brain Accessibility And Focus QA
acceptanceCriteria: all note buttons remain keyboard focusable native buttons
vault list exposes role=listbox and active descendant
vault note options expose role=option and aria-selected
graph exposes role=listbox and active descendant
graph nodes expose role=option, aria-selected, aria-controls, and accessible labels
inspector is focusable, labelled, and aria-live polite
focus-visible styling exists for buttons and tabindex targets
mobile target count stays above 10 with zero cramped targets in the dedicated smoke
screen-reader labels do not claim private Obsidian import or live AI access
manualReviewChecklist: Tab through toolbar, note list, graph, inspector, tables, and gate sections
Select every vault note with keyboard focus visible
Select every graph node with keyboard focus visible
Confirm inspector title/summary changes and receives a visible focus ring
Confirm reduced-motion users do not need animation to understand graph state
Confirm status copy preserves Local Demo, planned, disabled, and human-review labels
wcagFocusChecks: logical focus order matches visual reading order
focus target is not obscured by sticky bars or windows
reduced motion respected for graph state
screen-reader status names mock, planned, disabled, and local-demo states honestly
